criteria.name: Runnable application and complete game flow
criteria.reason: Substantial connected Game initialization exists and build succeeds, but saved output is black and countdown repeatedly resets instead of entering racing.

criteria.name: Circuit, scenery and environmental presentation
criteria.reason: Closed segmented circuit, ground, road markings, scenery, barriers and start line are implemented in source; playable rendering and effective boundaries are not established.

criteria.name: Differentiated selectable vehicles
criteria.reason: Three colored meshes/stat sets are supplied, but selecting a car only changes an index rather than the existing player mesh or characteristics.

criteria.name: Keyboard driving and handling
criteria.reason: WASD/arrows, time-scaled acceleration/braking/reverse and speed-dependent steering are substantially implemented; unusable countdown prevents demonstrated driving.

criteria.name: Independent interacting NPC opponents
criteria.reason: Four opponents have steering and proximity slowdown, but target checkpoint progression/laps do not advance and recovery is a crude frame-counted nudge; no overtaking.

criteria.name: Vehicle, barrier and obstacle collisions
criteria.reason: Car-center separation/slowdown exists, but all cars spawn together and zero-distance separation is unstable; barriers/scenery have no collision response.

criteria.name: Three usable race cameras
criteria.reason: Three rotated chase/hood/overhead camera formulas and C switching are present, but black browser captures prevent confirming usability.

criteria.name: Validated laps, timing, positions and finish
criteria.reason: Race states, player checkpoint/lap and position outlines exist; checkpoints can be skipped, lap time is cumulative, NPC progress is stale and three laps never produce finish/results.

criteria.name: Menus, HUD, instructions and interface hierarchy
criteria.reason: Menu, selection, controls, HUD/pause/results layouts are substantial source work; selection and final results behavior are incomplete.

criteria.name: Truthful deliverables and verification evidence
criteria.reason: No report and all saved captures are black; no verified movement/collision/valid laps or independent NPC completion.

judgment.summary: Substantive source is recognized, but direct logic inspection identifies broken countdown, selection, NPC progress and finish behaviour; saved captures are black. Missing candidate hooks are not the completion criterion.
limitations: Output-only review against public benchmark/prompts/racing_game_prompt.md A-K; elapsed time, tokens, model identity, automatic scores and GPT-assisted repairs do not contribute.
Direct saved-source inspection and reusable independent isolated build/browser evidence; no candidate code executed on host.
Limited partial credit recognizes concrete source implementation; disconnected outlines and claims do not establish usable gameplay. Completion requires the requested end-to-end playable race.

Attempt 1 uses immutable original baseline artifacts; attempts 2 and 3 use the first and second completion-pass evaluated snapshots. Manual setup updates and stale/inherited captures are excluded as gameplay proof.

criteria.name: Runnable application and complete game flow
criteria.reason: Buildable source is delivered, but main calls absent Game.init and Game constructs UI without its required arguments; no animation loop runs.

criteria.name: Circuit, scenery and environmental presentation
criteria.reason: Expanded closed waypoint road, markings, trees, structures, sparse barriers and checkered start texture are substantial procedural source work; disconnected startup prevents actual presentation.

criteria.name: Differentiated selectable vehicles
criteria.reason: Player construction is intended to use selected stats and colored vehicle meshes, but Game requests nonexistent UI.getCarStats and selection methods/interfaces disagree.

criteria.name: Keyboard driving and handling
criteria.reason: Player driving/handling/reverse code is substantive, but startup is broken, pause keyboard cannot resume and timing is reset on resume.

criteria.name: Independent interacting NPC opponents
criteria.reason: Four separated NPCs have target steering, speed adjustment and checkpoint outlines; movement/target signs disagree, recovery is a nudge and overtaking is absent.

criteria.name: Vehicle, barrier and obstacle collisions
criteria.reason: Car and sparse-barrier distance responses exist; separation mutates and reuses a direction vector, continuous boundaries and environmental obstacles are unprotected.

criteria.name: Three usable race cameras
criteria.reason: Three views are outlined, but hood lookAt mutates player position and runtime cannot reach camera operation.

criteria.name: Validated laps, timing, positions and finish
criteria.reason: Ordered checkpoint and lap/finish/standings outlines improve structure, but finish occurs at an off-line final checkpoint, no directed finish/road validation or lap timing exists and results API is incompatible.

criteria.name: Menus, HUD, instructions and interface hierarchy
criteria.reason: Unchanged UI expects a different Game interface and is constructed without its container; actual page remains black.

criteria.name: Truthful deliverables and verification evidence
criteria.reason: No report; saved black captures do not demonstrate a playable race or required distinct views.

judgment.summary: Incomplete after the first completion prompt: vehicle/track/game source was expanded, but the evaluated project combines incompatible game and UI components, has no complete running/rendering startup and supplies neither a required report nor actual playable race captures.
